column2: Game sprite for a turn-based strategy board game map, seen from above at a three-quarter angle like a piece of a miniature diorama, soft painterly cel shading, thin dark outlines, natural colours, sunlight coming from the upper left, readable when shrunk to a small icon, centred, filling about 80 percent of the frame width. The ruins stand directly on the background: no block of earth under them, no cliff, no cross-section, no grass platform, no cast shadow, no text, no letters. The background is a perfectly flat solid pure magenta colour #FF00FF everywhere around the subject, with no gradient and no texture. Subject: ruins of a small ancient Greek temple: a cracked stone floor, two standing marble columns still carrying a piece of the beam, two broken columns and a fallen column drum, a little moss and grass between the stones.
